dataset_and_split_fingerprints.index_convention: train/validation indices address official train set; test indices address official test set

interpretation.comparison: Descriptive comparison: epoch budget, CPU hardware, operating system, CPU instruction-set architecture, and native numerical backend changed together. Accuracy differences cannot be attributed solely to extra epochs; timing ratios do not isolate a hardware effect.
interpretation.seed_statistics: Means and sample SD across three training seeds, all using the same 10000 test images; not 30000 independent test cases and not confidence intervals for the mean.
interpretation.same_mac_progression: Best validation checkpoint through epoch 10 versus through epoch 25 on the same run trajectory. Validation-selected, descriptive, and not an independent test estimate of the extra-epoch effect. More candidate checkpoints can improve a selected validation maximum.
interpretation.uncertainty: Individual Wilson accuracy and bootstrap macro-F1 intervals are conditional on the fitted model and an iid sampling assumption; they exclude seed variability and distribution shift.
interpretation.timing: Training wall time includes validation/checkpoint work but excludes setup and download. Forward timings use preprocessed inputs after warmup, excluding I/O, transforms, loading, and softmax. RSS covers the whole process lifetime, including data and metrics.

test_metrics.interval_interpretation: Conditional on this fitted model; iid held-out test examples; excludes seed variation

performance.peak_rss_scope: Whole process lifetime, including dataset, training, and metrics
